terms.name: Light
terms.description: Little weight in the liquid; Light is not automatically watery

terms.name: Oily
terms.description: Slick, lubricating sensation; does not claim actual oil

terms.name: Not noticed
terms.description: No layer-like sensation noticed remaining after swallowing

terms.name: Noticeable
terms.description: A layer-like sensation remains after swallowing

terms.name: Not noticed
terms.description: No increase in mouth or throat dryness noticed

terms.name: Slight
terms.description: Mouth or throat feels slightly drier

terms.name: Moderate
terms.description: Mouth or throat feels moderately drier

terms.name: Strong
terms.description: Mouth or throat feels strongly drier

terms.name: Comfortable
terms.description: Swallowing and the throat feel comfortable

terms.name: Irritated
terms.description: Uncomfortable irritation during or after swallowing

terms.name: Tight
terms.description: A constricted or tightening throat sensation

terms.name: Foggy
terms.description: Thinking feels muddled or less clear

terms.name: Focused
terms.description: Easier to stay with one thing

terms.name: Energized
terms.description: More activated or ready to act

terms.name: Drowsy
terms.description: Sleepy or less alert; may be welcome

terms.name: Warmth
terms.description: Whole-body warmth, distinct from mouth/throat sensations

terms.name: Coolness
terms.description: Whole-body coolness, distinct from mouth/throat sensations

terms.name: Tingling
terms.description: Whole-body tingling, distinct from mouth/throat sensations

terms.name: No clear change
terms.description: No change noticed during the period described; not an intensity of zero

terms.name: Musty
terms.description: Closed, stale, damp-room/fabric association; not a mold diagnosis

terms.name: Paper/cardboard-like
terms.description: Paper, old books or cardboard; dry/damp nuance may be personal wording

terms.name: Ferment-like aroma
terms.description: Fermented-material association; does not establish its cause

terms.name: Perfume-like
terms.description: Perfume association, distinct from simply floral

terms.name: Plastic-like
terms.description: Plastic association; does not prove packaging caused it

terms.name: Other unfamiliar odor
terms.description: An odor the person cannot name; do not automatically add beside a named odor

terms.name: No distinct storage character
terms.description: None detected; not certification of cleanliness

terms.name: Mostly masks it
terms.description: Much of the other character is obscured

flavorDefinitions.Fresh fruit: Resembling fresh fruit or its peel.
flavorDefinitions.Dried fruit: Resembling fruit after drying or concentrating.
flavorDefinitions.Sweet & creamy aromas: Honey-like, sugar-like, or creamy aromas, whether or not the sip tastes sweet.
flavorDefinitions.Vegetal: Resembling green plants, vegetables, or dried grasses.
flavorDefinitions.Earth & fungi: Earthy, mushroom-like, or leathery associations; Earthy is the broad observation.
flavorDefinitions.Earthy: A broad earthy association; the broad observation for Earth & fungi.
flavorDefinitions.Stone & metal: Stone-like or metallic sensory comparisons; Mineral-like is the broad observation.
flavorDefinitions.Mineral-like: Stone/metal sensory comparison; no claim about mineral content or origin.
flavorDefinitions.Burnt: Scorched-food association; typically a drawback, but remains available in the descriptive wheel.
flavorDefinitions.Chalk: Chalk-like flavor; physical powderiness or grittiness belongs in Feel.
flavorDefinitions.Osmanthus: Fragrant flower often compared with apricot.
flavorDefinitions.Dried longan: Dried fruit with a sweet, dark-fruit association.
flavorDefinitions.Camphor: Sharp, aromatic wood-like association; not a claim camphor is present.
flavorDefinitions.Bitter: Bitter taste, whether welcome or unwelcome.
flavorDefinitions.Several layers: Several distinguishable impressions; neither inherently better.
flavorDefinitions.One main character: One dominant impression; neither inherently better.
flavorDefinitions.Returning sweetness · Hui gan: Sweetness appears or becomes clearer after swallowing, sometimes as bitterness fades.
flavorDefinitions.Aftertaste: A taste or aromatic impression that remains after swallowing.

semantics.valence: Visibility mapping only: positive = S, negative = W, neutral = S+W. Both shows the deduplicated union; Undecided shows all; Ordinary skips guided exploration. Never infer the person’s appraisal from a term.
semantics.energyAbsence: Explicit absence is a separate answer, not a sixth experiential aspect. Unrecorded energy remains unknown.
semantics.storageCrossReferenceRule: Shared terms use the same underlying flavor observation with an explicit storage association. Do not duplicate the note or infer storage from a flavor selection.
semantics.storageLimits: Sensory storage associations do not establish age, location, humidity, contamination, or safety.
semantics.oilyCoatingDistinction: Oily is slickness while drinking; Coating is a layer sensation remaining after swallowing. Neither implies the other. Smooth and Oily can coexist.
semantics.selection: Body, coating, drying and salivation each take one answer for the moment described. Textures and local sensations can coexist. Throat descriptions may coexist across places or moments. Storage allows multiple aromas and one optional masking answer. Selecting a term supplies no default intensity, timing, or appraisal.
semantics.absence: Not noticed explicitly records non-detection for the period described; untouched records no answer.
semantics.assessment: Both permits Strength and Weakness together. Unmarked defaults to Undecided for navigation without manufacturing a recorded assessment. Changing assessment changes suggestions and never deletes observations or details.
semantics.intensity: Feel, Energy and Storage use Slight / Moderate / Strong. Avoid a second intensity question for Drying. Flavor-note intensity remains Subtle / Moderate / Pronounced.
semantics.energyDevelopment: Optional whole-energy details: onset While drinking / After drinking; progression Stayed steady / Built gradually / Came in waves; duration Brief / Sustained / Long-lasting; ongoing Still feeling it is separate. One answer per question; all optional.
semantics.storageAcrossInfusions: Clears / Softens / Persists / Becomes more apparent were rejected as controls and must not be reintroduced.
